title: An $O(1/T^3)$ algorithm for minimizing convex quadratic functions over the $L_1$ ball
summary: We study convex quadratic minimization over the unit $L_1$ ball in which the maximum eigenvalue of the Hessian matrix is bounded by a positive constant $L$. We propose a novel first-order algorithm with objective value error bounded by $O(L/T^3)$ after $T$ gradient evaluations, assuming that the subproblems involved in the algorithm can be solved exactly. To the best of our knowledge, the best convergence rate of algorithms in the literature is $O(L/T^2)$.
